title: My First English Class · 写作迁移
instructions: 给一位新同学写2—8个简单句、至少12词。I 指你自己，You 指收到留言的同学；可以用真实或自编的信息。先独立写原稿，再按反馈订正，不照抄课文或完整示例。
prompt: Write 2–8 simple sentences to a new classmate. Introduce yourself with I am, then say one thing about the classmate with You are. Use your own information or an invented situation. Write at least 12 words. Do not copy the lesson example.
